node.statement: Group-defect guards: put y=e*delta+delta^2>=0. For q=I and q=A, C_grp^q<=C_grp^0<=C_grp and C_pol^q<=C_pol^0<=C_pol. Hence C_grp^q*e<=C_grp*e<delta-C_pol*y<=delta-C_pol^q*y. These are respectively the group-defect hypotheses of lem-stage1-inversion-derivative-control and lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws.
